title: Pharmacy Pickup Pickup Wait Leaderboard
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pharmacy:pickup pickup_wait_minutes=*
| stats sum(pickup_wait_minutes) as total_value, avg(pickup_wait_minutes) as avg_value by pharmacy_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks pharmacy values by total and average pickup wait across pharmacy pickup events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `pickup_wait_minutes` values for each pharmacy pickup event and review total and average pickup wait by pharmacy.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total pickup wait.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which pharmacy shows the biggest pickup wait numbers in your pharmacy pickup data.
